hooks.text: 最多六名巫师爪牙潜入对手高塔，以破坏钢琴、堵厕所等恶作剧累积当晚破坏指标。
hooks.excerpt: Break their piano, clog their toilets, pee on their rug - do anything in your power to ruin the archmage’s day. Every inconvenience you create gives you more points towards your vandalism target for the night.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 法术可推拉、砸飞、漂浮、传送、克隆、迷惑、伪装甚至把目标变成鱼，共同制造沙盒混乱。
hooks.excerpt: Find and use magic way beyond your understanding to push, pull, smash, launch, float, teleport, clone, confuse, disguise, fishify and more. Work together with your teammates to create a sandbox of chaos.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 施法必须亲口念出咒语，发音准确度会在危急环境中直接影响法术。
hooks.excerpt: Use your voice to cast wizardly incantations - enunciation matters so you better keep your voice steady no matter how dire the circumstances.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 模糊画质长时间观看会头晕。

excerpts.excerpt: 画质是糊糊的感觉，我看久了比较晕
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 角色设计可爱、有趣且容易记住。

excerpts.excerpt: The character design is cute and entertaining and even memorable making them quite unique.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 敌人过强且缺少可应对手段，只能逃跑。

excerpts.excerpt: 强大到你拿他没招 只能逃的敌人
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 当前内容更像技术Demo，预告中的内容几乎就是全部。

excerpts.excerpt: What you see in the trailer is quite literally everything in the game.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 核心循环重复，机制会随时间变得乏味。
中文语音识别长期无法可靠识别普通话。

excerpts.excerpt: 用中文识别不出来，你在开玩笑吗？
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 荒诞合作挑战能带来大量笑声与配合乐趣。

excerpts.excerpt: offers tons of laughter and teamwork as you tackle absurd challenges together.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 语音施法机制少见且很酷。

excerpts.excerpt: your spells are voice activated! Which is a super cool mechanic that you do not see often.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 和朋友一起念咒语会让乐趣加倍。

excerpts.excerpt: 跟朋友一起玩就会好玩加倍
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
